mapper.select: SELECT study.cancer_study_id AS cancer_study_id, active_release.release_id AS release_id FROM cancer_study study INNER JOIN ( SELECT cancer_study_id, argMax(release_id, (released_at, release_id)) AS release_id FROM wsi_release GROUP BY cancer_study_id ) active_release ON active_release.cancer_study_id = study.cancer_study_id WHERE study.cancer_study_identifier = #{studyId} LIMIT 1

SELECT study.cancer_study_id AS cancer_study_id, portal_patient.internal_id AS patient_id, active_release.release_id AS release_id FROM cancer_study study INNER JOIN patient portal_patient ON portal_patient.cancer_study_id = study.cancer_study_id AND portal_patient.stable_id = #{patientId} INNER JOIN ( SELECT cancer_study_id, argMax(release_id, (released_at, release_id)) AS release_id FROM wsi_release GROUP BY cancer_study_id ) active_release ON active_release.cancer_study_id = study.cancer_study_id WHERE study.cancer_study_identifier = #{studyId} LIMIT 1
